The controlled vocabulary of the question registry

Source: R/questions.R
question_statuses.Rd

status:

open

asked, no answer and no proposal

proposed

we have an answer to approve, not a problem to hand over — proposed_answer holds what we did or suggest, and the provider is confirming it

answered

settled; answer holds the resolution

wontfix

closed without an answer, deliberately

Usage

question_statuses()

question_priorities()

Value

Character vector of the allowed values.

Details

priority: blocker (the ingest cannot be released as-is), high, normal, low.

Examples

question_statuses()
#> [1] "open"     "proposed" "answered" "wontfix" 
question_priorities()
#> [1] "blocker" "high"    "normal"  "low"
